title: Reading vector
description: A test vector of reading (section 7 of the text of the part): exports, unpacked, and what section 5 gives. A reader implements section 5 and gets exactly this.

files.description: The files of the export, a map from each file's path — those of api.zip under api/ — to the file: a file of JSON as its value, a .proto file as its text. Any JSON value, as a reader of the vector gets it.

accepted.description: The reader accepts the export. Left out when it refuses it.

refused_by.description: The step that refuses the export: the schema, or the ID of the rule. Left out when the reader accepts it.

items.description: A file by its path, or a place in a file of JSON, its path and the place joined by #.

names.description: Every name that step gives, in the order of code units.
